432:t_001:22.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's go, everyone! We'll take down this base and rescue $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_001:23.en:
$$レド$$
「And then we'll free this planet from you!」

432:t_001:24.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, now, no need to get so worked up. Shall we cool down a little?」

432:t_002:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the hell did you do!」

432:t_002:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I have taken the liberty of lowering everyone's fighting spirit. It is an application of the dimensional transfer cannon and the scorpion's poison.」

432:t_002:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Nostalgic, isn't it, $$クロウ$$?」

432:t_002:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You never stop getting on my nerves, do you.」

432:t_002:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「So getting hit by that does mental damage...!」

432:t_002:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Now that we've come this far, there's no retreating! Get through the damage to your hearts with your own willpower!」

432:t_002:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「If it's a contest of guts, I won't lose!」

432:t_002:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! We'll charge with hard work and guts!」

432:t_002:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! Target the enemy commander, $$サルディアス$$!」

432:t_002:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is $n going to be all right on his own?」

432:t_002:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「He said he would push himself to the limit and climb back up from there.」

432:t_002:15.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That positive attitude... We should follow his example.」

432:t_002:16.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Maybe the Chief's advice is what worked...)

432:t_002:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hang on, $$セツコ$$! I'm coming to save you right now!!」

432:t_002:18.en:
$$シン$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't let you do whatever you want with $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Impressive. You didn't break through all those traps for nothing.」

432:t_003:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then allow us to present you with a special gift from our side.」

432:t_004:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Chasing Miss $$スズネ$$, chasing $$セツコ$$... You really are greedy, $n.」

432:t_004:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s mood has changed...?」

432:t_004:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「This is... more hatred than ever before...!」

432:t_004:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh heh... $$セツコ$$... $$スフィア$$ compatibility means nothing...」

432:t_004:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Because thanks to you, I was able to build up even more hatred.」

432:t_004:9.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So love and hatred are two sides of the same coin.」

432:t_004:11.en:
$$桂$$
「This guy... when it comes to $$セツコ$$...」

432:t_004:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't peer into people's hearts.」

432:t_004:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Losing your temper because you were teased about the woman you like... You're just like an adolescent boy.」

432:t_004:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't make me laugh. This feeling of mine is... love?」

432:t_004:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I just... want to kill $$セツコ$$ so badly I can't stand it!」

432:t_004:16.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Lecturing a kid about the shape of love is boring. I'll give you something else instead.」

432:t_004:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! That is the taste of defeat!」

432:t_004:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Go ahead and try! If a bunch like you can, that is!」

432:t_004:19.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Watch out! He's tougher than ever!」

432:t_004:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if we just take this guy down, we can save $$セツコ$$!」

432:t_004:21.en:
$$シン$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't hand $$セツコ$$ over to you!」

432:t_005:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is this all you've got, $c?」

432:t_005:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「He really is stronger than when we fought him before...!」

432:t_005:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll make you regret your arrogance in saying you'd give me defeat.」

432:t_005:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I see... I'll acknowledge your strength.」

432:t_005:5.en:
$n
「But finishing you off is not our job.」

432:t_006:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Thank you, everyone. I'm sorry for worrying you.」

432:t_006:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... By being near you, I was able to touch your heart, just a little.」

432:t_007:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ is losing its power...!?」

432:t_008:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... When I touched your heart, I was filled with a sorrow unlike any I've ever known...」

432:t_009:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I want to free you from your hatred...」

432:t_011:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Stop! Don't look at me with those eyes!!」

432:t_011:5.en:
$$シン$$
「But how did you get out of the base?」

432:t_012:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Was it you who rescued $$セツコ$$?」

432:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No one but me has the right to do as they please with her.」

432:t_004:11: Kei's trailing line 'when it comes to Setsuko...'
